title: Integrating Gaussian Accelerated Molecular Dynamics, beta-Variational Autoencoders, and Markov State Models Reveals the Activation Landscape of FGFR3 Kinase.
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文整合GaMD增强采样、beta-VAE降维和马尔可夫状态模型，揭示FGFR3激酶磷酸化与配体结合调控的构象激活景观，是典型的蛋白质构象采样与结构计算研究，方法创新且直接契合本课题。
abstract: Fibroblast growth factor receptor 3 (FGFR3) kinase plays a crucial role in cellular differentiation, proliferation, and skeletal development. Activation of the kinase domain through phosphorylation regulates the downstream signaling cascades, and its dysregulation leads to human dwarfism, skeletal dysplasia, and multiple cancers. However, the mechanistic basis of FGFR3 regulation by phosphorylation and ligand binding remains unclear. Here, we introduce an integrated GaMD-betaVAE-MSM pipeline, a hybrid physics-ML framework for studying kinase activation. Gaussian-accelerated molecular dynamics (GaMD) enhances simulations by reducing the energy barrier. The variational autoencoder with tunable regularization was used for nonlinear dimension reduction and identifying slow collective variables. The Markov state model (MSM) was used for identifying metastable states spanning active-inactive conformations. Our results show that phosphorylation drives pronounced domain rearrangement and activation-loop dynamics. The coordinated movement of the molecular brake and regulatory spine governs the kinase activation. Ligand interaction stabilizes the active phosphorylated state with a free energy of -19 kcal/mol. Protein structure network analysis uncovers the long-range allosteric pathways. The potential regulatory sites involving alphaCbeta4, beta34, and beta45 loops can be further exploited for allosteric intervention. Overall, this study highlights that phosphorylation and ligand binding dual regulate FGFR3 kinase through allosteric communication networks. The integrated GaMD-betaVAE-MSM pipeline provides mechanistic insights into FGFR3 activation and may help the rational design of next-generation FGFR3-targeted therapeutics resistant to gatekeeper mutants.
abstract_zh: 成纤维细胞生长因子受体3（FGFR3）激酶在细胞分化、增殖和骨骼发育中起着至关重要的作用。通过磷酸化激活激酶结构域可调控下游信号级联，而其失调会导致人类侏儒症、骨骼发育不良和多种癌症。然而，FGFR3受磷酸化和配体结合调控的机制基础仍不清楚。在此，我们引入了一个集成的GaMD-betaVAE-MSM流程，一种用于研究激酶激活的混合物理-机器学习框架。高斯加速分子动力学（GaMD）通过降低能垒来增强模拟。具有可调正则化的变分自编码器用于非线性降维和识别慢速集体变量。马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）用于识别跨越活性-非活性构象的亚稳态。我们的结果表明，磷酸化驱动显著的域重排和激活环动力学。分子制动器和调控脊的协调运动控制激酶激活。配体相互作用以-19 kcal/mol的自由能稳定活性磷酸化状态。蛋白质结构网络分析揭示了长程变构通路。涉及alphaCbeta4、beta34和beta45环的潜在调控位点可进一步用于变构干预。总体而言，本研究强调磷酸化和配体结合通过变构通讯网络双重调控FGFR3激酶。集成的GaMD-betaVAE-MSM流程为FGFR3激活提供了机制见解，并可能有助于合理设计抗守门员突变体的下一代FGFR3靶向治疗药物。
